name: Residual gated JK-sum
tagline: Per-layer Bahdanau-style sigmoid gates scale node features by (1+gate) before sum pooling, then concatenate batch-normed graph vectors over layers.
formula: $$ g^{(\ell)}_v = \sigma\!\left(W_2^{(\ell)} \tanh(W_1^{(\ell)} h^{(\ell)}_v)\right),\quad z^{(\ell)} = \mathrm{BN}_\ell\!\left(\sum_{v\in V} (1 + g^{(\ell)}_v)\,h^{(\ell)}_v\right) $$ $$ \text{readout} = \big[\, z^{(1)} \,\Vert\, \dots \,\Vert\, z^{(L)} \,\big] $$

key_hyperparams.name: gate hidden
key_hyperparams.role: bottleneck width of the per-layer gating MLP

key_hyperparams.name: residual offset
key_hyperparams.role: additive base in (1+gate) so unattended nodes still contribute

init_recovers: GIN JK-sum readout when gates collapse to 0
diff_from_baseline: Versus the gin_sum baseline this adds a per-layer node-attention gate and uses a residual (1+gate) multiplier rather than replacing the sum, so worst-case behaviour matches GIN-JK while important nodes can be amplified up to 2x.

name: Saliency-modulated JK-sum
tagline: Standard JK-sum readout, but each layer's graph vector is scaled by a graph-specific modulator derived from degree-aware salient deviations of node embeddings.

key_hyperparams.name: modulator scale
key_hyperparams.role: amplitude of layer-wise tanh modulation around 1.0

key_hyperparams.name: saliency stat
key_hyperparams.role: gate-weighted first/second moment of centered node features

diff_from_baseline: Versus gin_sum it adds a degree-aware per-graph attention summary that produces small (±0.1) per-layer scalar modulators on the JK-concatenated layer vectors. The base JK-sum + per-layer BN backbone is preserved, modulation is near-identity at init.

name: Learned sum/mean/max JK mix
tagline: Per layer, take sum/mean/max pools, mix them with a learnable softmax (initialized as pure sum), batch-norm, then JK-concatenate across layers.
formula: $$ w^{(\ell)} = \mathrm{softmax}(\theta^{(\ell)}),\;\theta^{(\ell)}_{\text{init}} = (3, 0, 0) $$ $$ z^{(\ell)} = \mathrm{BN}_\ell\!\left( w^{(\ell)}_1 \sum_v h^{(\ell)}_v + w^{(\ell)}_2 \mathrm{MEAN}_v\, h^{(\ell)}_v + w^{(\ell)}_3 \max_v\, h^{(\ell)}_v \right) $$ $$ \text{readout} = [\, z^{(1)} \,\Vert\, \dots \,\Vert\, z^{(L)} \,] $$
diff_from_baseline: Versus gin_sum, replaces the fixed sum readout per layer with a learnable softmax mixture over {sum, mean, max}; the mixture logits start at (3, 0, 0) so the model degenerates to JK-sum at init and only deviates if training prefers it.
